sources.title: Kimi Open Platform: New Feature Release Log
sources.evidence: The November 6, 2025 entry explicitly records the official launch of Kimi K2 Think and its turbo version.

sources.title: Model List
sources.evidence: Lists kimi-k2-thinking-turbo separately from kimi-k2-thinking under deprecated K2 models, with the original K2 series discontinued May 25, 2026.

sources.title: Moonshot API pricing page bundle, archived November 6, 2025
sources.publisher: Moonshot AI; preserved by Internet Archive
sources.evidence: The page bundle linked by the archived /docs/pricing/chat HTML identifies kimi-k2-thinking-turbo as a high-speed version of kimi-k2-thinking with 256k context. The K2 section supports ToolCalls and excludes vision. Its explicit same-model-parameters statement names kimi-k2-turbo-preview, not Thinking Turbo.

sources.title: Kimi Code CLI: Interaction and Input
sources.evidence: Explicitly names kimi-k2-thinking-turbo as a model that always uses thinking mode and cannot disable it.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: The downloadable standard Thinking checkpoint has nominal 1T total and 32B activated parameters, MoE architecture, 256K context, native INT4 quantization and Modified MIT licensing. The card does not identify a Turbo checkpoint or explicitly equate the Turbo endpoint with these weights.

sources.title: Kimi K2.5: Visual Agentic Intelligence
sources.evidence: The later February 2026 technical report discusses standard K2 Thinking and experiments using it, but does not name Thinking Turbo or supply a Turbo-specific parameter count or checkpoint mapping.

sources.title: Kimi-K2.5 model card and comparison tables
sources.evidence: The later card gives K2.5-specific architectural counts and compares models, but does not identify Thinking Turbo as a checkpoint or give its counts. Its shared quantization-method reference names standard Kimi-K2-Thinking.

sources.title: Kimi Code CLI configuration files
sources.evidence: An example for the exact kimi-k2-thinking-turbo identifier sets max_context_size to 262144. Used only to corroborate the numeric interpretation of the independently advertised 256K budget; illustrative capability flags are not treated as endpoint specifications.

sources.title: Tool Calling Specification Violation on Moonshot API
sources.evidence: Moonshot staff provide an exact kimi-k2-thinking-turbo text chat-completions request with function tools and discuss fixes to tool-schema handling.

sources.title: An Update on New K2 Models and New Pricing
sources.evidence: The November 7 announcement explicitly introduces both Thinking endpoint names for complex reasoning, multi-step instructions and tool/function calling; it confirms the Turbo model launched with the November 6 pricing.

name.note: Readable form of the exact first-party kimi-k2-thinking-turbo endpoint name.

developer.note: Moonshot publishes and announces this exact API model.

family.note: The developer groups the exact Thinking Turbo endpoint within the Kimi K2 series; normalize to kimi-k2.

release_date.note: Official release log explicitly dates both K2 Think and its turbo version to November 6; this is not inferred from the standard checkpoint date.

open_weights.note: The standard Thinking weights are public, but no accessed first-party source establishes exact checkpoint equivalence for the hosted Turbo variant. High-speed version alone does not prove identical released weights; clear the baseline true.

license.note: Modified MIT is verified for standard K2 Thinking weights, not this exact hosted Turbo model. No established checkpoint mapping supports transferring that license, and missing mapping does not establish proprietary weights.

parameters_b.note: Standard Thinking nominal 1T is not an exact tensor count and is not transferred to Turbo without an explicit parameter/checkpoint mapping. Later K2.5 report and model-card comparison tables were checked and do not resolve Turbo; this is an unresolved verification, not a claim that Moonshot never disclosed it.

active_parameters_b.note: Standard Thinking nominal 32B activated is distinct from total parameters and cannot establish Turbo active parameters without a matching checkpoint declaration. No count was inferred from packed INT4 storage or scales.

architecture.note: The standard checkpoint is MoE, but the accessed primary sources do not explicitly map the exact Turbo endpoint to that checkpoint. Later technical research does not supply a Turbo-specific architecture; retain null.

context_window.note: The archived launch-day API pricing page explicitly advertises 256k for this exact endpoint, corroborated as 262144 in Moonshot CLI configuration for the same identifier. This is the documented historical context budget, not a larger checkpoint positional ceiling or a claim of current endpoint operation.

modalities.note: The historical K2 API documentation excludes vision and staff show exact Turbo text chat-completions/function calls. Retain text input and output; do not inherit image support from illustrative CLI capability flags.

reasoning.note: Exact-model first-party CLI guidance explicitly classifies Turbo as always thinking with no disable switch; the launch announcement also names reasoning support.

tool_call.note: The API pricing section and exact-model staff request explicitly establish tool/function calling.

description.value: High-speed Kimi K2 Thinking API variant for text reasoning and tool calling; the original Moonshot endpoint is deprecated.
description.note: Describe the specifically documented hosted variant and its lifecycle, avoiding unsupported transfer of standard-checkpoint long-horizon benchmarks.

patch.description: High-speed Kimi K2 Thinking API variant for text reasoning and tool calling; the original Moonshot endpoint is deprecated.
patch.notes: Historical Moonshot API speed variant, released November 6, 2025 and listed as deprecated since May 25, 2026. Its advertised 256K context is represented as 262144 tokens; always-thinking and tool calling are explicit. Public standard K2 Thinking weights have nominal 1T total/32B activated parameters and Modified MIT licensing, but exact Turbo checkpoint equivalence was not verified, so openness, license, counts and architecture remain unknown. Do not interpret the standard Thinking weights link as a verified Turbo checkpoint.

sources.label: Moonshot historical Turbo API specifications (archived page bundle)

summary: Confirmed the exact Turbo endpoint release on 2025-11-06, historical 256K context, text input/output, always-on reasoning and tool calling; current Moonshot docs mark it deprecated. Corrected family to kimi-k2, replaced generic description and cleared unsupported open_weights=true. Standard Thinking weights, nominal 1T/32B counts, MoE architecture and Modified MIT license were not transferred without explicit Turbo checkpoint equivalence. Five fields remain unverified (openness, license, total/active parameters and architecture).
